# E8 QUARANTINE: every fit, threshold and selection in this file is made on E3-E7 only; E8 rows are ONE labeled blind read and were never an input to any choice.
# WHICH COMPONENT CARRIES THE DAY-RANK ORACLE'S DOLLARS.  A day score is written Z_cell + W_within with both parts normal-scored onto one scale, and one part at a time is replaced by noise.
# WITHIN_ONLY_random_placement keeps PERFECT within-cell ordering and destroys cross-cell placement — it is what a perfect renormalisation of a perfect within-cell score would bank.
# CROSS_ONLY_random_within keeps perfect cell PLACEMENT and destroys the ordering inside each cell.

# HINDSIGHT.  Not deployable, not fitted, and never a promotion target: this exists to aim the build.  If WITHIN_ONLY carries most of the oracle, renormalising the champion is the multiple-jump; if CROSS_ONLY carries it, the placement model is the aimed attack.
